## What lives here
The credential vault: encrypted values bound to their entry, versions, audit, resolution for allowed consumers, and scrubbing.

## Conventions
Values are never listed. `VAULT_MASTER_KEYS` holds the keys, newest first.

## Entry points
`store.py` and `routes/vault.py`.
